body:
> For some inexplicable reason, pd.read_hdf opens files in append mode rather than read-only, so I pass 

this is the default for ``PyTables``. append allows you to read/write files, but won't erase the file if it exists (``w``).
Does `pd.read_csv` open the CSV in append mode? Perhaps `pd.read_hdf` should not use the PyTables default.

> Does pd.read_csv open the CSV in append mode? Perhaps pd.read_hdf should not use the PyTables default.

no, that is read-only.  (though you can open the file yourself in append mode if you wanted)

The difference of course is that PyTables acts more like a database, where you generally both read and write, while a file you generally don't.
we had this discussion here FYI: https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/13623
OK, that discussion is off-topic here. If you want to make a method called 'read_X' open a file for writing, that's your right, but please at least make it possible for me to open it read-only.
well if you submit a PR to fix that would be helpful
